description: This file defines a FastAPI application with two POST endpoints for file upload: one accepting raw bytes and the other accepting an UploadFile object. It includes route handlers that process incoming files and return basic responses.

methods.name: create_file(file: Annotated[Union[bytes, None], File()] = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/files/' to receive a file as bytes or None and returns its size or a message indicating no file was sent.

methods.name: create_upload_file(file: Union[UploadFile, None] = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/uploadfile/' to receive an UploadFile or None and returns the filename or a message indicating no upload file was sent.

ctags.name: create_file
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_file(file: Annotated[Union[bytes, None], File()] = None):$/
